question: What kind of details should be included in my welcome package when I first sign up for a mobile service?
reference_answer: When you enroll, your welcome package must include your SIM card, your phone number (unless you transferred it from another provider), whether your service is prepaid or postpaid, customer support contact information, a summary of your consumer rights, and instructions on how your service might be deactivated if you stop using it. [1], [2]
evidence: consumers at the time of enrolment into the network, containing, inter alia,---- (a) SIM card, if applicable; (b) a mobile number, in cases where the subscriber is enrolled other than through mobile number portability; (c) information about the type of connection- prepaid or post-paid;

question: Who is accountable for making sure my text messages get to the right place if I switched carriers?
reference_answer: The carrier where the message starts is accountable for ensuring it is sent to the correct destination. [1]
evidence: Every Access Provider on whose network a message originates shall be responsible for the correct routing of such message.

question: How do I get the special code I need to switch my phone number to a new carrier?
reference_answer: You will receive this code automatically via a text message generated by the system. [1]
evidence: through an automated system generated SMS containing a unique porting code.

question: If I just switched my service provider recently, am I allowed to move my number again immediately?
reference_answer: No, you cannot switch again immediately. If you have already changed your service provider, you must wait at least 90 days before you can request to move your number again. [1]
evidence: the mobile number has been ported earlier and, if so, a period of ninety days has not elapsed from the date of its last porting

question: Can I keep my recharge plan active for longer than three months now?
reference_answer: Yes, the limit for keeping these specific types of plans active has been increased from 90 days to up to one year, matching the rules for data-only plans. This change is intended to save you from having to top up your account so often. [1]
evidence: the cap on validity of STV and CV be extended from present ninety (90) days to three hundred and sixty-five (365) days.

question: Do telecom operators have to offer a plan for just calls and texts, and how long can it be valid?
reference_answer: Yes, the provider must offer at least one special plan for voice and text that is valid for no more than one year. [1]
evidence: validity period not exceeding three hundred and sixty-five days

question: I’m an Airtel customer registered on the Do-Not-Disturb registry but still get spam texts. Where can I file a complaint?
reference_answer: Airtel customers registered on the DND registry can file a DND complaint using the DND complaints form on Airtel’s website at airtel.in/dnd. [1]
evidence: DND complaints form available at http://www.airtel.in/dnd.

question: How long does Airtel take to refund my security deposit after I close my service?
reference_answer: Airtel's service benchmark is to refund deposits within 60 days of closure, for 100% of cases, assessed over a quarter. [1]
evidence: 100% within 60 days

question: Does Airtel guarantee that my broadband will be installed by a specific date?
reference_answer: No. Airtel does not guarantee a specific date for installing or activating the service, though it states it will try to do so within a reasonable period. [1]

question: How can I check on the progress of an issue I reported to my phone company?
reference_answer: Your service provider is required to set up an online portal that allows you to track the current status of any problems you have reported. [1]
evidence: establish a ‘Web Based Complaint Monitoring System’ to enable the con sumers to monitor the status of their complaints.

question: What is the minimum font size for the printed details on a paper recharge voucher?
reference_answer: Printed voucher information, including features and activation restrictions, must be in a font size of not less than eight points. [1]
evidence: information about the features, including activation restrictions, are printed in font size of not less than eight points.

question: How do I switch off mobile data using an SMS?
reference_answer: Send an SMS with STOP to 1925 to deactivate the data service. The operator confirms the request by SMS, and the service is deactivated within four hours. [1]
evidence: “STOP” to 1925 for deactivation of data service

question: How can an Airtel customer stop unwanted telemarketing calls?
reference_answer: Airtel customers can register their number in the NDNC (Do Not Disturb) registry by calling 1909 or sending the SMS 'start dnd' to 1909. [1]
evidence: send sms "start dnd" on 1909

question: Can I keep my current phone number if I decide to switch to a different phone company?
reference_answer: Yes, you are able to keep your existing phone number when changing to a different service provider, as this service is known as Mobile Number Portability [1].
evidence: ‘Mobile Number Portability’ is the facility which allows a subscriber to retain his mobile number when he moves from one access provider to another access provider in the country.

question: How will I know how much I'll be charged for using my phone while traveling abroad?
reference_answer: Once you choose a plan for international roaming, your service provider is required to send you the pricing details for calls, texts, and internet usage via text message, email, and their app if they have one. [1]
evidence: provide to the consumer through SMS, email and mobile application, if available, the following information:- (i) the applicable rates for provision of voice, SMS and data services while roaming internationally

question: When I call my operator's consumer care number and use the automated menu, can I get to a live agent?
reference_answer: Yes. The sub-menu at the third level of the automated menu must include an option that lets the consumer speak to a consumer care agent. [1]
evidence: the sub-menu in the third level shall also contain an option enabling the consumer to speak to a consumer care agent

question: What does my old operator have to do about refunds after I port my number to another operator?
reference_answer: After the number is disconnected as part of porting, the old (donor) operator must refund the subscriber within the time frame and in the manner set out in the Standards of Quality of Service. [1]
evidence: the Donor Operator shall refund to the subscriber, within such time frame and in such manner as specified in the Standards of Quality of Service

question: How can an Airtel customer find out the tariff for roaming?
reference_answer: Roaming tariffs differ by operator. Airtel customers can get tariff details by calling Customer Care at 121 or by visiting the Airtel website. [1]
evidence: Details of tariff may be obtained from Customer Care (by calling 121) or visiting the website www.Airtel.in

question: I'm an Airtel customer and I'm not happy with how my complaint was resolved. What can I do?
reference_answer: Airtel customers who are dissatisfied with the resolution can share the reason for dissatisfaction, and Airtel's team will re-assess the complaint and provide a resolution within 10 days. [1]
evidence: In case the resolution is not as expected then you may share with us the reason for dissatisfaction and our team will re-assess your complaint and provide resolution within 10 days.

question: For the alternate digital KYC process to get a new SIM, what if I don't have my own alternate mobile number?
reference_answer: If the customer does not have an alternate mobile number of their own, the mobile number of a family member, relative or known person may be used for this purpose. [1]
evidence: if the customer does not have any own alternate mobile number then mobile number of his/her family members/relatives/known persons may be used for this purpose

question: For a corporate mobile number, how quickly must the porting request be forwarded to the porting service provider?
reference_answer: For a corporate mobile number, the request must be forwarded to the Mobile Number Portability Service provider within forty-eight hours of receiving the porting request, excluding intervening Sundays and public holidays. [1]
evidence: the time period for forwarding the mobile number etc. to the Mobile Number Portability Service provider shall be forty eight hours

question: If I upgrade my SIM while I still have my original working SIM, do I face a porting restriction?
reference_answer: TRAI's view is that there is no need for porting restrictions in the case of SIM upgradation. [1]
evidence: the Authority is of the view that there is no need for porting restrictions in case of SIM upgradation.

question: If I try to cancel my plan via text but send the wrong code, what happens?
reference_answer: If you send an incorrect response, the company will text you back with the list of plans currently active on your phone and ask you to pick the right one to cancel. [1]
evidence: an SMS shall be sent to the consumer giving him again the list of STVs activated on his mobile number

question: How must my operator tell me about the conditions under which my connection can be deactivated?
reference_answer: The operator must give this information through the start-up kit and customer acquisition form, tariff leaflets or brochures, display on its website, retail points of sale and complaint centres, and publication in an English and a regional-language newspaper every six months. [1]
evidence: liable to be deactivated

question: I just switched to a new operator. How long do I have to wait before I can port my number again?
reference_answer: Per Airtel's consumer charter, a customer can move to another mobile service provider only after 90 days from the date of activation of the mobile connection or from the date of the last porting of the mobile number, whichever applies. [1]
evidence: The Customer is allowed to move to another mobile Service Provider only after 90 days of the date of activation of mobile connection or from the date of last porting of mobile number

question: Can my number be ported while a change of ownership of the number is being processed?
reference_answer: No. Under the MNP regulations, a porting request can be rejected if a request for change of ownership of the mobile number is under process. [1]
evidence: a request for change of ownership of mobile number is under process

question: Will my phone company tell me if I'm about to get hit with huge fees for using my phone while traveling abroad?
reference_answer: Yes, your service provider is required to warn you if you might be charged much higher rates for data, calls, or texts when you are outside of your plan's coverage area. [1]
evidence: alert and advise the consumer regarding the possibility of incurring significantly high charges

question: How do I request the unique porting code I need to switch my number to another operator?
reference_answer: Every access provider must set up a mechanism in its mobile network to receive an SMS from its subscribers requesting a unique porting code, and forward the request to the Mobile Number Portability zone the number belongs to. [1]
evidence: Every Access Provider shall set up, in its mobile network, a mechanism for the purpose of receiving Short Message Service (SMS) from its subscribers requesting for a unique porting code

question: Under the alternate digital KYC process for new SIMs, how many mobile connections can one customer get per day using the same ID document?
reference_answer: Only two mobile connections can be provided per day using any one of the POI/POA documents. If more than one connection is issued, the entire process must be repeated for each connection. [1]
evidence: Only two mobile connections shall be provided per day by using any one of the POI/POA documents to a customer

question: If I already have a court case going on about my complaint, do the TRAI complaint redressal regulations still apply to that matter?
reference_answer: No. The regulations do not apply to any matter or issue for which proceedings are pending before any court or tribunal. [1]
evidence: Nothing contained in these regulations shall apply to any matter or issue for which-- (a) any proceedings before any court or tribunal are pending

question: How can I find out which value added services are active on my number?
reference_answer: Every service provider must set up a separate toll-free short code that lets consumers request information about their account through SMS, including the value added services activated on their number. [1]
evidence: Value Added Services activated on his telephone number

question: If my current carrier doesn't reply to my request to switch, how soon will my number move?
reference_answer: If the carrier you are leaving does not respond to your request to switch, the porting process will be scheduled within the following thirty-six hours, and you will receive a text message notification. [1]

question: I asked my operator for the code to port my number but never received it. Why might that happen?
